title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.57
summary: Quiet Gallery navigation with a gradual shade and fading selection highlight.

sections.heading: A softer expanded sidebar
bullets: A continuous shade blends navigation into the artwork with no hard boundary.
A small cyan accent and fading highlight replace the rectangular selection outline.
Collapsed browsing, icon choices and remote navigation stay the same.

sections.heading: Your setup stays saved
bullets: Use Update BlackLanturn to keep settings, authorizations, saved data and other installed add-ons.
The visual change adds no background monitoring, blur or extra provider work.
